Synthetic fixtures for DB-02 offline tests.

Every value is invented: documentation-range addresses (192.0.2.0/24), a made-up serial and placeholder credentials. They follow the field structure documented in docs/S30Pro_WZRD_research_2026-10-08_UPDATED.md, docs/research/S30Lab/ and seestarpy 0.7.1 documentation. They are not hardware captures. Real captures, if any, must be sanitized first and must never include keys, addresses, serials or Wi-Fi data.
